workshop_nodes.short_description: Integrity branch: add durability at milestone levels.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Tower Core upgrades improve consistency and grant an additional life at major milestones instead of becoming a raw damage ladder.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Kinetic branch: modestly strengthen rapid-fire output.
workshop_nodes.long_description: This branch improves the Rapid Fire module while preserving the need to choose pierce, bounce, or rate upgrades during a run.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Explosive branch: improve area pressure without solving every matchup.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Cannon progression supports splash and burn routes, but in-run choices still decide whether the build handles armor, speed, or swarms.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Arcane branch: stabilize sustained beam damage.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Arcane Beam progression improves reliable sustained pressure while leaving chain and status specialization to the upgrade draft.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Control branch: make reaction windows more consistent.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Frost progression supports slowing and freezing, but electric or shatter follow-up is still a strategic in-run commitment.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Precision branch: improve high-value target pressure.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Railgun progression strengthens focused damage without removing its area-coverage weakness, which must be solved through upgrades.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Economy branch: earn more temporary run Credits.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Credit Relay progression improves run economy and enables future shop decisions, but does not directly replace damage upgrades.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Control branch: extend slow-based reaction windows.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Stasis Field progression helps control builds stabilize fast waves while remaining weaker against control-resistant threats.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Defense branch: make leak recovery more reliable.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Repair Drones progression improves survival cadence without granting a universal damage multiplier.

workshop_nodes.short_description: Status branch: reward burn and poison setups.
workshop_nodes.long_description: Corrosion Amp progression makes established status builds more effective, but offers little value before a status route is assembled.
